nodes.title: Quick OpenPose Character Concept Sheet
widgets_values:
Quick OpenPose Character Concept Sheet V1.2
-------------------------------------------

This is just a Quick OpenPose Character Concept Sheet designer.  It's Very simple, and I use it all the time - So I thought I'd Just share it with everyone.  It will create two OpenPose images based on your choice of head and body positions.  One for SDXL Base OpenPose ControlNet model compatibility and one for SD base OpenPose ControlNet model compatibility.  I personally find these sizes to be optimal.

🟪 Face and Character Positions 🟪

Defaults are good, but you have some freedom here to pick the rotation and position of the head and body.

I added Just head and Just Body - Which will better aid if you want to bring in your own Character and use this to create their Character Concept Sheets.  Bacially you would IPAdapter the head and then the body seperatly - I find if you try to do these together then you get weird results in the head images.  I will add examples to bonus content later.

🟦 Own Image Injector 🟦

Example of how to use ipadapters to bring in your own characters.

🟩 Example Usage - Own Image Concept 🟩

Here is just a quick set of nodes thrown together as an example of what you can do.
You can tweak the nodes as desired.


Good luck and have fun! - Lord Lethris (twitch.tv/Lord_Lethris)
